items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had dinner at his house in Kansas City once... Sarah Vaughan, George Treadwell, Dexter Gordon, we all went by there and had dinner

ctx.x: And then we can start the second half of the show. And there was another time, in what we called the Big Show of '51, which was the first big package show, this was with the Ellington Band. Oh, we had the Marie Bryant Dancers and Peg Leg Bates, Stumpy and Stumpy, Patterson and Jackson, Jimmy Rodgers, Nat Cole, and we were going into Pittsburgh. Now, normally Sarah had what was called the choice spots. She'd close the first half. There's no pressure there. Nat Cole was the only one, King Cole was the only one that…
